project.name: OliveExpress™ Logistics Platform
project.description: Production logistics platform for Dar Al-Nas ecosystem with QuranChain integration, AI-powered dispatch, and multi-regional operations (USA, Mexico, Jordan). Includes a Python-based Telegram bot for educational AI interactions.

patterns.validation: Always use Zod schemas for input validation and type inference
patterns.error_handling: Use ApiException from chanfana for API errors
patterns.database_models: Define models with tableName, primaryKeys, and Zod schema
patterns.api_endpoints: Extend OpenAPIRoute from chanfana, use handleValidationError for errors
patterns.routes: Use Hono routers for organizing endpoint groups

imports.order: External libraries first, then local imports
imports.style: Use named imports, avoid default exports except for main app

patterns.async: Use async/await for Telegram bot handlers
patterns.logging: Use Python logging module, get logger with __name__
patterns.dataclasses: Use dataclasses for simple data structures

hono.usage: Main application framework for Cloudflare Workers
hono.bindings: Use Hono<{ Bindings: Env }> for type-safe environment access

chanfana.usage: fromHono(app, { docs_url, schema }) for OpenAPI setup
chanfana.endpoints: Extend OpenAPIRoute class for all API endpoints
chanfana.validation: Use handleValidationError for consistent error responses

zod.purpose: Runtime type validation and TypeScript type inference
usage: Define schemas for all data models
Access via c.env.DB in request handlers
Use parameterized queries to prevent SQL injection
Apply migrations with 'npm run seedLocalDb' (local) or 'npm run predeploy' (production)

fastapi.purpose: Python async web framework for Telegram bot

usage: Register handlers with CommandHandler, CallbackQueryHandler, MessageHandler

schema.tables: 28+ tables including shipments, carriers, ports, corridors, contracts, escrow_accounts, etc.
conventions: Use snake_case for table and column names
Primary keys are usually 'id' INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT
Use TIMESTAMP columns with DEFAULT (datetime('now')) for created_at/updated_at
Use CHECK constraints for enum validation
Use FOREIGN KEY constraints with ON DELETE CASCADE or ON DELETE SET NULL appropriately

migrations.content: Include both schema definitions and seed data where appropriate
migrations.rollback: D1 migrations are forward-only, plan changes carefully

patterns: RESTful endpoints with proper HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE)
Use /oliveexpress prefix for logistics platform endpoints
Use /tasks prefix for task management endpoints
Return consistent response format: { success: boolean, result?: any, errors?: [] }

validation.input: Validate all inputs with Zod schemas in endpoint Query/Data classes
validation.errors: Return validation errors with code and message

openapi.schemas: Define separate Query and Data classes for request validation

halal_finance: Transparent founder economics (2.5% royalty on commercial, 0% on humanitarian)
ai_guardrails: AI responses are educational only, not financial/legal advice
Escalate sensitive topics to human review
OpenAI is optional; use canned responses if API key absent
security: No wallet custody - never store or request private keys
All secrets from environment variables only
governance: Optional jurisdiction gating via ALLOWED_COUNTRIES env var

patterns: Test API endpoints with sample requests
Test database operations with local D1 instance

development.database: npm run seedLocalDb (applies migrations to local D1)
development.type_generation: npm run cf-typegen (generates Cloudflare Worker types)

production.pre_deploy: npm run predeploy (applies migrations to production D1)
production.deploy: npm run deploy (deploys to Cloudflare Workers)

production: Deploy to Railway with Procfile: web: python -m daralnas_bot.server
Set environment variables in Railway dashboard
Server auto-configures Telegram webhook on startup

quranchain_integration.description: Blockchain-based shipment contracts and escrow system

ai_systems.aman_control: Carrier trust scoring (0-100 based on performance)
ai_systems.delay_prediction: ML-based delay forecasting with confidence levels

multi_regional_operations.usa: 8 ports (LA, Long Beach, NYC, Savannah, Houston, Miami, DFW, Memphis)
multi_regional_operations.mexico: 6 ports (Veracruz, Manzanillo, Lázaro Cárdenas, Tijuana, Mexico City, Juárez)
multi_regional_operations.jordan: 4 ports (Aqaba Sea, QAIA Air, Amman Land, Aqaba Rail)

src/.index.ts: Main application entry point, Hono app setup, OpenAPI configuration
src/.endpoints/: API endpoint implementations organized by domain

endpoints/tasks/.task*.ts: Individual endpoint implementations (Create, Read, Update, Delete, List)

endpoints/oliveexpress/.purpose: Logistics platform API (shipments, carriers, QuranChain, AI)
endpoints/oliveexpress/.models.ts: Zod schemas for all database models

daralnas_bot/.purpose: Python Telegram bot for educational AI interactions
daralnas_bot/.templates/: HTML Mini Apps (daralnas.html, quranchain.html, meshtalk.html, fungi.html)

migrations/.pattern: Sequential SQL files with schema and seed data

telegram_bot.WEBHOOK_URL: Optional for local development, required for production
telegram_bot.ADMIN_ID: Optional - numeric Telegram admin user ID
telegram_bot.ALLOWED_COUNTRIES: Optional - comma-separated country codes for jurisdiction gating (e.g., 'UAE,SA,UK')

general: Write type-safe code with strict TypeScript checking
Validate all external inputs with Zod schemas
Use meaningful variable and function names
Add comments only when necessary to explain complex logic
Keep functions small and focused on single responsibility
Use async/await consistently, avoid callback patterns
database: Always use parameterized queries to prevent SQL injection
Handle database errors gracefully with try-catch
api: Document all endpoints with OpenAPI schemas
Implement proper authentication and authorization (DarCloud identity)
security: Never log sensitive data (tokens, API keys, wallet addresses)
Validate and sanitize all user inputs
Implement rate limiting on public endpoints
compliance: No custody of user funds or keys

add_new_endpoint: 3. Define Query and Data Zod schemas for validation
4. Implement getSchema() method for OpenAPI docs
5. Implement handle() method with business logic
add_database_table: 2. Define table schema with proper constraints
4. Run 'npm run seedLocalDb' to test locally
add_telegram_command: 3. Add message content in messages.py if needed
